Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Zelor Iverek: 20-year-old man, 162 cm (short), conditioned athletic construction with functional tone but no ripped definition, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: long narrow face; large hooded eyes and a broken brow line; prominent bridge, compact mouth; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: brown-chestnut, braids-twists-locs, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: mantle-short-cape, specifically a small mantle or short cape over an unarmored tunic and divided lower layers; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette plum-gray. Visible personal details: contrasting boot laces; a patterned collar insert. Make the garment hem and outer silhouette the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: low-maintenance grooming with highly polished footwear. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: torso angles three-quarter while both arms hang in deliberate asymmetric ease. Include a folded handkerchief only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
